I would encourage everyone, whether you agree with Bernie Sanders about this or or not, to read into the principles of Basic Income.

Basic Income would essentially be a stipend unconditionally paid to all individuals of a population, regardless of their financial situation. Arguments have been made that it may actually cost less to implement a basic income system in the United States than it does to staff and fund our current social programs. Obviously, this would be dependent on how the system were implemented, but the concept is certainly worth examining.
